The structure of Ca4Cr2Co8O16 (reduced formula Ca2Cr(CoO2)4) is monoclinic, space group C2/c (No. 15), with 30 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ca and Cr each coordinated by six O neighbors, while Co adopts octahedral six-fold O coordination and O centers are two- or three-coordinate toward Co. The Co octahedra share corners and edges with each other, and the geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and fully connected across all 30 sites.
